name: Zurich Rock 'n' Roll Madrid Marathon

trackSource.notes: Official GPX file (zrnrrsm-42k-2026.gpx) downloaded from the race website; the exact file URL was not recorded.

notes: On 2026-11-27 the regulations gave 25 April 2027 and the first start as "por determinar".
